THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT(this "Agreement") is entered into as of the 29th day of December, 2025, by 213 Yorkville LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 40 72nd Street, Brooklyn, New York 11209 ("Owner"), and 213 Yorkville LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 40 72nd Street, Brooklyn, New York 11209 ("Developer"). WITNESSETH: 1529 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York, and known as and by street address 211 East 83rd Street, New York, New York 10028, as more particularly described in Exhibit "A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof ("Owner Land"), together with the building and improvements thereon, (the “Owner Building", together with the Owner Land, collectively hereinafter called the"Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the fee owner of that certain land, designated as Tax Lot 8 in Block 1529 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York, and known as and by the street address 213-215 East 83rd Street, New York, New York 10028, as more particularly described in Exhibit “B"” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (*Developer Land"), together the building and improvements thereon, (the “Developer Building"); and WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct a new building (together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, the “New Developer Building") upon the Developer Land (the Developer Land, together with the Developer Building and/or the New Developer Building, the “Developer Parcel"), with a bulk in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) if the Developer Land were considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; and WHEREAS, there are Development Rights appurtenant to the Owner Land that are in excess of the Development Rights utilized by the Owner Building or retained by Owner as of the date of this Agreement and are available for transfer in accordance with the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, Owner and Developer have agreed to utilize the procedure available under Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution to combine the Owner Land and the Developer Land so as to confirm the existence of and declare a single zoning lot, which zoning lot may be enlarged making available the Subject Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) for use in connection with the construction of the New Developer Building; WHEREAS, all “parties in interest" (as defined in the Zoning Resolution) to the Single Zoning Lot have either executed the Declaration (hereinafter defined) or have waived or have previously waived their right to do so, and have either executed this Agreement or subordinated or previously subordinated their respective interests in the Single Zoning Lot hereto; "Business Day” means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday or other day on which commercial banks are authorized to be closed in the State of NewYork. 5. “Bonus Development Rights"”means any bonus floor area and other development rights that are or may become available to the Single Zoning Lot by (1) the provision of an amenity or public benefit, either on or off the Single Zoning Lot, and/or (2) a transfer from a zoning lot that is not included in the Single Zoning Lot, including bonus floor area generated as-of-right, (3) by special permit, authorization or certification, in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, or (4) by Discretionary Approval. 6. “"Casualty” shall mean an event that causes such demolition, damage, destruction, loss or other similar event such that the Owner Building or the Developer Building, or any other building or improvement located on the Single Zoning Lot (as the case may be) cannot be lawfully restored to such building or buildings’ former bulk pursuant to the provisions of the Zoning Resolution regulating the redevelopment of non-complying buildings. 7.
